title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E01 — Dinosaur Cowboys
Dinosaur fossil season has begun, and Montana rancher Clayton Phipps finds what might be an extremely rare and valuable fossil on his family's property.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E02 — Million-Dollar Dino
Clayton Phipps continues his excavation of a rare carnivorous dinosaur on his Montana ranch; Mike Harris and son Jake prepare to sell their prized Tyrannosaurus rex fossil; Aaron Bolan hunts for an Ankylosaurus.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E03 — Curse of the Carnivore
Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis; Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull; Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E04 — Shots Fired
Clayton must haul his 20,000-pound dinosaur fossil over 200 miles to a lab where it will finally be identified; the Harris/Bolan clan chases poachers off of their land; Jared makes a last-ditch effort to bring in some money this season.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E05 — We Got Skull
Clayton returns to his ranch in Montana to hunt for quick finds at Old Faithful. In Wyoming, Mike Harris and his team continue excavating their triceratops site hoping to uncover the valuable horns.

title: Dino Hunters
description:
S01 E06 — The Verdict Is In: Nano or T-Rex
In Montana, Clayton Phipps prepares to learn if his carnivore skeleton belongs to a Tyrannosaurus rex or the controversial Nanotyrannus; in Wyoming, Mike Harris and Aaron Bolan race against the impending winter digging at a promising new site.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E05 — Blood for the Snake God
New discoveries reveal the bloody origin of the feathered snake god, and experts investigate why the ancient Mesoamericans believed that human sacrifice was the only way to appease the deadly monster.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E10 — Hunting the Loch Ness Monster
New discoveries reveal the truth behind the Loch Ness Monster, and experts investigate the world's most mysterious waters in search of evidence that a prehistoric monster could still be lurking in the deep.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E06 — Wrath of the Minotaur
A new excavation at the mysterious home of the Minoans leads to a startling discovery about real-life origins of the Minotaur, and experts decode artifacts that point to bloody human sacrifices for the ferocious monster.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E07 — Dark Secrets of the Sphinx
New discoveries uncover the dark secrets of Egypt's strange half-man, half-lion beast, revealing why the pharaohs were so intent on transforming into this powerful and ferocious monster.

title: Mythical Beasts
description:
S01 E09 — Call of the Werewolf
Werewolves were once so feared, people suspected of the power were hunted and killed, but even so, many admitted that they could become these deadly creatures, and new evidence reveals why a powerful hallucinogenic drug could be to blame.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E09 — Lost World of Desert Kings
The ancient city of Samarra contains a series of medieval structures that hold secrets to one of the world's greatest empires; archaeologists use pioneering technology to investigate its astonishing rise to power and reveal its monumental downfall.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E05 — Lost City of the Sumerian Gods
The sacred city of Nippur and the world's only ziggurat contain elusive mysteries to the ancient Sumerian people; now, archaeologists armed with pioneering tech are on a quest to reveal the secrets behind the earliest known civilization in history.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E10 — Rome's Lost Coliseums
The coliseums of Rome were brutal theaters of spectacle and death that helped control the sprawling Roman Empire; now, archaeologists uncover the engineering secrets behind these majestic structures to reveal the truth behind the ancient Roman world.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E11 — Legend of Xanadu
The legendary metropolis of Xanadu and its fabled existence have mystified experts for centuries; archaeologists use cutting-edge aerial imaging to investigate new discoveries and reveal the truth behind this mythical lost city.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E06 — Egypt's Island of Secrets
A colossal stone temple on a remote Egyptian island mysteriously bears the names of the most famous leaders of the ancient world; now, experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate why pharaohs and emperors all built monuments at this enigmatic site.

title: Unearthed
description:
S09 E07 — Egypt's Cult Kings
The ancient city of Abydos contains some of the oldest Egyptian tombs and a buried temple linked to a mysterious death cult; now, archaeologists use cutting-edge drone imaging to investigate long-hidden secrets behind the first pharaohs.

title: Cleopatra: Sex, Lies and Secrets

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E02 — Aliens vs. Stalin at Area 51
When a former Area 51 insider alleges that the Roswell UFO incident was a nefarious Soviet conspiracy masterminded by Stalin, experts investigate if it was indeed an enemy plot against America -- or if the confession is just another cover-up.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E02 — Fire in the Cockpit
Some believe the fire on Apollo One that killed three astronauts was a top-secret cover-up, and a team of experts investigates if this disaster was a tragic accident or part of a conspiracy to fake the moon landing.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E01 — NASA Nazi Conspiracy
A team of experts investigates if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncovers a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space program.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E05 — CIA's Secret Space War
Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E03 — Killing Armstrong
Apollo 11's lunar module nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training, and some believe this close-call could explain a conspiracy to fake the moon landing; investigating if dangers that the Apollo 11 crew faced were motive for a cover-up.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E04 — Conspiracy of the Lost Tapes
The NASA tapes that recorded the Apollo 11 moon landing are missing, and some believe their disappearance is part of a cover-up to hide the truth; experts use cutting-edge tech to hunt for this lost evidence and shed light on a possible conspiracy.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E06 — The Hollywood Conspiracy
Some believe that the moon's waving American flag is the smoking gun that NASA faked the moon landing, and as a team of experts investigates this strange piece of evidence, the trail leads all the way to some of Hollywood's biggest names.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E05 — Curse of the Armada Graveyard
A cutting edge investigation into a deep-sea graveyard of 25 shipwrecks reveals the dark secrets of the biggest naval battle in history, and using the latest tech, experts follow new evidence into the mysterious abyss of long-lost battleships.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E01 — Bermuda Triangle: Hunt for the Cotopaxi
The disappearance of the SS Cotopaxi helped launch the legend of the Bermuda Triangle; a team of experts follows fresh leads with cutting-edge tech to investigate if a mysterious wreck off the coast of Florida is indeed the long-lost ship.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E02 — Ghost Fleet of Doom
New discoveries reveal the treasures of a ghost fleet of Japanese ships at the bottom of the South Pacific, and using cutting-edge underwater technology, experts investigate a top-secret superweapon that could have changed the course of World War II.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E03 — Haunting at Lake Erie
A mysterious shipwreck at the bottom of Lake Erie could be the oldest wreck in America's most notorious ship graveyard, and using cutting-edge underwater archaeological methods, experts investigate new leads in this 200-year-old cold case.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
Nazis in the Bermuda Triangle
New evidence in the Bermuda Triangle could reveal that Nazis got closer to America than ever believed; using the latest cutting-edge underwater technology, experts investigate the truth behind the shipwreck that shouldn't exist.

title: Shipwreck Secrets

S01 E04 — Titanic's Lost Sister
When a sister ship of the Titanic gets embroiled in war with a hidden enemy, the former luxury liner is sent to the bottom of the ocean; new discoveries and cutting-edge underwater technology might finally reveal the secret history of its sinking.
